scope: Actual pool page/load/progress with controlled bridge/current-round/guard fixtures; real browser mouse and three landscapes; no player data or natural match claim.

checks.name: first failed read never fabricates zero unlocks or zero-progress rows
first failure is retryable and does not expose parser diagnostics
valid source restores exact known unlock and manual reward controls
successful retry does not strand focus on a hidden retry button
collapsed signature does not query parent live context eagerly
opening current signature reads actual compatible steps on demand
explicit refresh adopts newer current-round state
refresh retains original native button focus after queued toggle
invalid live data is retryable and never means satisfied
historical achieved signature never borrows another live round
read failure retains all previously accepted unlocks rather than resetting history
cached read is never authority for claiming money
direct old handlers cannot claim while unread
structurally invalid snapshot cannot replace known history
corrected source re-enables authoritative claim controls
save guard cannot merge a newly adopted save into old page history
single claim rechecks source before sending despite a previously enabled button
healthy bulk path still sends exactly one original request
read failure stops batch continuation but retains accepted totals
closed page ignores new storage events and obsolete retry actions
actual HTML remains exception free
